quick test on cheer fastcouch, 9:16 and 16:9, pumpkins and fog over the cut. files are in ua masters

ok, i will redo both from the sep 16 capture
Hello Team! Reminding that I'll be on vacation Oct 6-15. <@EMPLOYEE_0005_SLACK_ID> takes the ad statics while I'm out, store art stays with me.
thanks martin. julia on the ad statics works for me
Hey Marcus, could you try a quick halloween pass on one of the current cuts when you have a minute? Just to see how it reads before we plan anything
did the cheer fastcouch one, both 9:16 and 16:9, from the no music masters. pumpkins and fog from the halloween pack, they're in UA masters in the halloween folder on the drive
halloween store screens are exported to the halloween folder :jack_o_lantern: same comps as the live sets with the seasonal layer on top
sounds good. whatever is already exported is done so no tickets needed for those, tickets are just for store art that still has to be made

<@EMPLOYEE_0009_SLACK_ID> halloween for ZM :jack_o_lantern: I'd like everything players see from us to look like halloween for the last stretch of october - store pages and every ad we're running. can you own the art side? go through everything that's live today and work out what gets a halloween version, what needs work first, what we already have, and who makes what by when
• the live creatives sheet is what's running
• Arthur's release calendar has the Q4 dates
• Robert has direction for seasonal art
• Frederick is sending his october UA plan tonight
• Martin has the icon and the stills, Marcus has video and end cards
maybe we swap the icon around the 24th?
put it all in a plan doc we can comment on plus a tracker. drop a comment on each ad's ART ticket with its call and due date, and assign the ones that need new work to whoever's making them so Frederick can queue the uploads. open tickets for any new store art and post the links here before thursday's review
Nice for an event, but not for the app icon, it gets too busy at that size. A Halloween icon should stay as simple as the one we have

Spoke to our Unity rep about this today. They're putting every new Android creative through manual review for the next few weeks, about 5 days each. So any new ad going on Android US phone has to be with me by Fri Oct 10, not the 15th. iOS UK stays on the 15th.

row.title: ZM3D release calendar — Q4
row.body_text:
Zombie Match 3D store submissions, Q4 2025. Owner: Arthur.
Oct 17 submission: the last build that can carry Halloween changes. Merge cut is Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. Anything that ships in the build has to be merged by then. Submit Fri Oct 17.
iOS screenshots can only change with a new version, so new iOS screenshots go up with the Oct 17 submission and are due by the same Oct 16 12:00 PT cut.
Apple review has been taking up to 3 days, so plan on that build and its iOS store listing being live from Wed Oct 22.
Google Play listing graphics are not tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review.
Nov 6 submission: post-Halloween clean-up (icon and screenshots back to normal).

row.text: Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025
Halloween and the holidays, store and ads
Before any seasonal pass

Seasonal dressing goes on top of the current art only. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the zombie swap with the new background, Jul 29) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture is the one that counts.
A video whose master has the music baked in is re-cut first from a master without music (re-export one from the project if there is none), so the seasonal pass can be edited.
What changes

Only the seasonal layer changes: pumpkins, fog, props, the title treatment. Same flat background, same pose, same zombie order, same CTA, so a seasonal variant still tests clean against its normal version.
Calls for the tracker

Halloween version: dress it from the current art.
Refresh first: re-capture, re-render or re-cut before any seasonal pass.
Reuse: it already has a seasonal version, use that one.
Skip: no seasonal version this time.
